requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4, and may be optional on trailers of category O1.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device may be optional.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., with α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: Where only one reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle, the reversing lamp shall have geometric visibility with β = 45° to right and to left.
requirements.quote: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: Where two reversing lamps are installed at the rear of the vehicle, the reversing lamps shall have geometric visibility with β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.quote: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: Where the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be considered to be ensured if the reference axis of the respective reversing lamp is directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The geometric visibility is considered to be ensured if the reference axis of the respective device is directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: If the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the reversing lamps shall also comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. above.
requirements.quote: In addition, if the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2., are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. above shall apply.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Moreover, the electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.

requirements.text: When the reversing lamps fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the reversing lamps shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control.
requirements.quote: (a) The devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control;

requirements.text: When the reversing lamps fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion, the reversing lamps shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control.
requirements.quote: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control;

requirements.text: When the reversing lamps fitted on the side of the vehicle have been automatically switched OFF because the forward speed exceeded 15 km/h, the reversing lamps shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.
requirements.quote: in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.

requirements.text: Where the component regulation requires a tell-tale indicating failure, the reversing lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S1 or S2 categories shall be present (mandatory) on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of S3 or S4 category shall be present (mandatory) on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have two S1 or S2 category stop lamps and one S3 or S4 category stop lamp on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp's point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of the stop lamp in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category devices, the centre of reference of the stop lamp shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, except that where two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle. However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: Where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset of the stop lamp shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional stop lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 categories devices, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of the stop lamp shall either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall: either not be more than 150 mm below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the exposed surface of the glass or glazing of the rear window, or not be less than 850 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category stop lamp shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
requirements.quote: However, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp's geometric visibility horizontal angle shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. However, for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 categories devices, the stop lamp's geometric visibility horizontal angle shall be 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp's geometric visibility vertical angle shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 categories devices, the stop lamp's geometric visibility vertical angle shall be 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 categories devices: 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously.
requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in width such that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the rear position lamp shall have no special requirement for the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, the optional rear position lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) Where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is chosen at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. is chosen and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres. The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. ... This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The tell-tale of the rear position lamp shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.text: If required by the component Regulation, the rear position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on motor vehicles, except that, provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, it is optional on trailers.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles. Provided that they are grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices, optional on trailers.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: have no special requirement;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground, except that it may be not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), and 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively.
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility with a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility with a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: All markings of the rear lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear lamp shall have a size defined by the value for "a" in Table 1.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the rear lamp shall consist of:
requirements.quote: The approval marking shall consist of:

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflector shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark on the retro-reflective device shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I (Unique Identifier (UI)).
requirements.quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark is affixed, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible, the retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough, and any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: When the retro-reflector is in normal use, there shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflector must be so designed that the optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

requirements.text: When the retro-reflector is white, red or amber, the test procedure for night time colours specifications shall apply to the retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: These specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices

requirements.text: When the colour of the retro-reflector is tested, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: When the colour of the retro-reflector is tested, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from the retro-reflector, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., the retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The applicant shall submit ten samples of the retro-reflector for approval, which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall submit ten samples for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: These two samples shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.
requirements.quote: These two samples shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.

requirements.text: Four samples out of the remaining eight samples shall be selected at random and divided into two groups of two in each group, and the other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two.
requirements.quote: Four samples out of the remaining eight samples shall be selected at random and divided into two groups of two in each group. The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two:

requirements.text: The two samples of the first group of the retro-reflector shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The two samples of the second group of the retro-reflector shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The two samples of the third group of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The two samples of the fourth group of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The verification of the RI of the retro-reflectors shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.quote: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.quote: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.
requirements.quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the red retro-reflector must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 shall not be permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values of the retro-reflector shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: Where the Type Approval Authorities authorize laboratories to omit certain unnecessary tests of the retro-reflector, the omission shall be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval, and the omission shall be applicable only to tests described in Part 3 of Annex 4, in Parts 4, 5 and 6 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Depending on the nature of the materials of which the retro-reflectors and, in particular, their optical units, are made, the Type Approval Authorities may authorize laboratories to omit certain unnecessary tests, subject to the express reservation that such omission must be mentioned under "Remarks" on the form notifying approval. This is only applicable to tests described in Part 3 of Annex 4, in Parts 4, 5 and 6 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB) and Table 5 (Class IVA), as applicable.
requirements.quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, except that if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε. If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements of the retro-reflective device for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflectors and retro-reflective marking materials, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflectors and retro-reflective marking materials, the immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: In the test for retro-reflectors and retro-reflective marking materials, the sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be such that no water penetrates to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, for the retro-reflector the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflector being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflector to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: For the resistance to corrosion test, the retro-reflector, or the rear lamp if the retro-reflector is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: In the case of a retro-reflector with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflector, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

requirements.text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection RA after the corrosion test, the surface of the retro-reflector shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: After the rear face of the retro-reflector has been brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the rear face for one minute, and the cotton cloth shall then be removed and the retro-reflector left to dry.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute. The cotton cloth is then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.

requirements.text: The RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

requirements.text: When a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol is applied to the retro-reflector, the outer surface of the retro-reflector and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: When a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol is applied to the retro-reflector, after about five minutes the surface of the retro-reflector shall be inspected visually.
requirements.quote: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.

requirements.text: After the test mixture has been applied and about five minutes have elapsed, the surface of the retro-reflector shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA and advance warning triangle of type 1, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA and advance warning triangle of type 1, after about 5 minutes of wiping with the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA and advance warning triangle of type 1, after the surface is cleaned, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall either specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: If an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.

requirements.text: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).
requirements.quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).

requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested at the test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

requirements.quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.

requirements.quote: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).

requirements.quote: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test of the rear lamp at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.

requirements.text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

requirements.text: During the radiated narrowband emission tests, the rear lamp under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.

requirements.text: When measurements are performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS), the rear lamp shall meet the limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.

requirements.quote: Note: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW)

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test of the rear lamp at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.

requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

regulations.rationale: Consolidated light-signalling device regulation that covers the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp, so it is the main device approval. (lexical: term match score 12.1)
Installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices on M1 vehicles. (lexical: term match score 30.1)
The built-in retro-reflector (Class IA) is approved under the consolidated retro-reflective device regulation. (lexical: term match score 3.9)
The product has LED electronics on a PCB, so it is an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) that needs EMC approval. (lexical: term match score 9.3)
Legacy regulation for position and stop lamps, replaced by R148. (lexical: term match score 1.5; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy regulation for reversing lamps, replaced by R148. (lexical: term match score 1.5; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy regulation for retro-reflectors, replaced by R150. (lexical: term match score 0.4; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
The LEDs are built into the lamp, not replaceable LED light sources of an approved category. (lexical: term match score 8.5)
Vehicle-level rules on external projections. A flush rear lamp is assessed at vehicle level, not as part of the lamp's own approval. (lexical: term match score 0.4)
The product has no direction indicator function. (lexical: term match score 0.4; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
The product has no rear fog lamp function, and this is a legacy regulation anyway. (lexical: term match score 0.7; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
The lamp uses no filament light sources. (lexical: term match score 0.4)
Covers the vehicle braking system. The stop lamp is signalling only. (lexical: term match score 0.4)
Covers road illumination devices such as headlamps and fog lamps, which is not this product. (lexical: term match score 4.2)
